tool.name: HyphAeon-MEME
tool.command: @SYMLINK_FILES@ hyphaeon meme -a input.$input_file.extension @INPUT_TREE@ @MODEL_VARIANT@ #if $advanced.max_species: -s $advanced.max_species #end if $advanced.no_prune_duplicates $advanced.filter_flag #if $advanced.filter_flag: --filter-p-thresh $advanced.filter_p_thresh --min-patch-consec $advanced.min_patch_consec #if $advanced.filter_out_aln: --filter-out-aln cleaned_alignment.fa #end if #end if $advanced.attribute #if $advanced.attribute: --attribution-min-lrt $advanced.attribution_min_lrt #end if @OUTPUTS@ #if $advanced.filter_flag and $advanced.filter_out_aln: && mv cleaned_alignment.fa '${filter_out_output}' #end if

param.label: Maximum species
param.help: Maximum number of taxa to include (farthest-point traversal subsampling if exceeded)

param.label: Disable duplicate pruning
param.help: Disable automatic collapsing of 100% identical sequence duplicates

param.name: filter_flag
param.label: Enable alignment QC filtering
param.help: Run automated dual-stage alignment error detection and surgical outlier masking (Hypergeometric Patch + Counterfactual Attribution)

param.label: Filter p-value threshold
param.help: Hypergeometric local patch p-value threshold for artifact detection

param.label: Min consecutive radical mutations
param.help: Minimum consecutive radical mutations in a single taxon to declare an alignment artifact

param.name: filter_out_aln
param.label: Export cleaned alignment
param.help: Write the cleaned (masked) alignment to an output file

param.label: Enable mechanistic feature attribution
param.help: Run single-taxon counterfactual sensitivity, Delta-LRT, and evolutionary epoch decomposition for significant sites

param.label: Attribution min LRT
param.help: Minimum LRT threshold to run feature attribution (default 3.84 = nominal p <= 0.05)

tool.help:
HyphAeon MEME: Episodic Positive Selection Inference =====================================================
**What question does this method answer?**
Which sites in a codon alignment are subject to episodic positive selection (selection acting on a subset of branches rather than pervasively across the entire tree)?
**How it works**
HyphAeon uses a transformer-based phylogenetic foundation model to score per-site selection via a likelihood ratio test (LRT). Unlike classical methods (e.g., HyPhy MEME), it leverages deep-time evolutionary patterns learned across the tree of life, enabling zero-shot inference without per-dataset model fitting.
**Inputs**
- An in-frame codon alignment (FASTA or NEXUS) - An optional phylogenetic tree (Newick or NEXUS); if omitted, HyphAeon will extract one from the alignment or estimate it
**Outputs**
- **JSON**: full per-site results including LRT, p-values, and (if attribution is enabled) counterfactual sensitivity scores - **CSV**: tabular per-site summary suitable for downstream plotting
**Advanced options**
- *Alignment QC filtering*: detects and surgically masks alignment artifacts (e.g., sequencing errors masquerading as radical mutations) - *Feature attribution*: for significant sites, decomposes the selection signal into contributions from individual taxa and evolutionary epochs - *Duplicate pruning*: by default, 100% identical sequences are collapsed to speed up inference; disable if you need per-isolate attribution
